 This week's nomination list features several popular contestants, making the elimination race particularly interesting
 Rasti Amena Follow on Twitter |   Published: 14th November 2026 5:32 pm IST Bigg Boss 20 contestants Manish Goel, Qazi Touqeer and ScoutOP (Instagram) Mumbai: The fear of elimination is looming large over the Bigg Boss 20 housemates as the contestants wait anxiously to find out who will end their journey this weekend. With Weekend Ka Vaar shoot taking place on Saturday, November 14, the suspense surrounding the latest eviction has finally come to an end, as television actor Manish Goel has reportedly been eliminated from the house after receiving the least number of votes.
 However, the eviction drama may not be over yet. Reports suggest that another contestant could also be shown the exit door this weekend, although the name of the second possible evictee has not been revealed so far.
 Manish Goel eliminated from Bigg Boss 20
 Manish Goel’s journey in the reality show has come to an end after he reportedly secured the least votes among the nominated contestants this week.
 Interestingly, Manish entered the Bigg Boss 20 house as the season’s first wildcard contestant during the Weekend Ka Vaar episode on October 10, 2026.
 Host Salman Khan introduced him through a playful prank, initially presenting him as a guest who had arrived to promote a show titled Ek Aur Sahi. However, the announcement soon turned into a surprise when Salman revealed that Manish was actually entering the house as a contestant.
 He entered the show alongside fellow wildcard contestant Nakul Dhull. While Nakul’s journey ended following a physical altercation inside the house, Manish managed to survive eliminations and continued his stint for over a month.
 Also Read Double elimination in Bigg Boss 20 house, Salman Khan furious Who all are nominated this week?
 This week’s nomination list features several popular contestants, making the elimination race particularly interesting. The nominated contestants are:
 Qazi Touqeer
 ScoutOP
 Yung DSA
 Gullu
 Kanika Mann
 Uditi Singh
 Love Gill
 Amrapali Dubey
 Manish Goel
 Mahhi Vij
 With Manish’s reported eviction, viewers are now waiting to see whether another housemate will be eliminated during this Weekend Ka Vaar.
 The identity of the possible second evictee remains unknown, and fans are eagerly waiting for further updates from the Bigg Boss 20 house.
 Stay tuned to Siasat.com for more interesting scoops and updates on the show.
